Whether the record should be the only one for that record type and record name. Only use with state. This deletes all other records with the same record name and type.
Whether the record(s) should exist or not.
CAA issue restriction. Required for type when state.
Custom tags for the DNS record.
The TTL to give the new record. Must be between 120 and 2 seconds, or 1 for automatic.
The type of DNS record to create. Required if state. Support for SPF has been removed from community.general 9.0.0 since that record type is no longer supported by CloudFlare.
The record value. Required for state.
